tests: the imported package is listed, but not ticked
steps:
1. Unzip import-package-unticked.zip (attached to the report; pack writes it), which holds import-package-unticked.twinproj and DocProbePkg.twinpack. Open the project in the twinBASIC IDE.
2. Open Project Settings > References > Available Packages and press Import from file...; choose DocProbePkg.twinpack.
3. DocProbePkg appears in the Available Packages list, unticked. The compiler has answered the importPackage request with success: true and body: { packageSymbol: "DocProbePkg" }, so the import worked. Expected: the package is ticked, as after the online import. Actual: nothing in the project can use it until it is ticked by hand.
Re-measured on BETA 995 by `ide-test.bat --only packages` (first test; its probe is test/ide/probes/packages); BETA 983 by hand. The lane has no native file picker, so it answers the dialog's OpenPackage call itself; the click on the button is real.
